IDS_AERIUM_BACKGROUND_PLAYBACK_SUMMARY: Keep audio and video playing when you switch away from Aerium or turn the screen off. Restart Aerium to apply.
IDS_AERIUM_BACKUP_EXPORT_SUMMARY: Open tabs, site permissions, browser and Aerium settings, and chrome://flags. Not passwords, history or cookies.
IDS_AERIUM_BACKUP_RESTORE_FAILED: Could not read that backup file
IDS_AERIUM_BACKUP_RESTORE_SUMMARY: Reopens the saved tabs, and brings back the saved permissions, settings and chrome://flags. Restart Aerium to apply.
IDS_AERIUM_BACKUP_SUMMARY: Save or bring back your open tabs, site permissions, settings and chrome://flags
IDS_AERIUM_BLACKEN_DARK_SITES_NEEDS_AUTO: Turn on Darken websites above to use this.
IDS_AERIUM_BLACKEN_DARK_SITES_SUMMARY: On: sites that ship their own dark theme have their dark grey taken to true black as well, not just the pages Aerium darkens itself. Restart Aerium to apply.
IDS_AERIUM_CLEAR_ON_EXIT_SUMMARY: Choose what is deleted every time you close Aerium
IDS_AERIUM_CLEAR_ON_EXIT_SWITCH_SUMMARY: The types below are deleted when you close Aerium. If the browser is closed by the system before that happens, they are deleted the next time it starts.
IDS_AERIUM_DRM_SUMMARY: Register the Widevine CDM so sites like Netflix can play protected video. Off by default: the CDM is proprietary Google software that Aerium does not ship, and a browser without one should not tell sites it has one. Restart Aerium to apply.
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_ALL_SITES_SUMMARY: The sites above become the exceptions. Everything else is signed out as soon as you close its last tab.
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_ALL_SITES_TITLE: Clear every site when its last tab closes
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_CLEAR_CACHE_SUMMARY: Applies to sites cleared when their last tab closes. Their images, fonts and scripts are fetched again on the next visit.
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_DELAY_DESC: Sign-in pages often open a tab that closes itself, so clearing the instant a tab goes can delete a cookie that was about to be used. A short wait also forgives closing a tab by accident. 0 to 3600 seconds.
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_DELAY_IMMEDIATE: As soon as the last tab closes
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_DELAY_INVALID: Enter a number of seconds between 0 and 3600
IDS_AERIUM_EPHEMERAL_DELAY_SUMMARY: SECONDS seconds after the last tab closes
IDS_AERIUM_EXTERNAL_DOWNLOAD_MANAGER_SUM: Offer each download to a download manager app instead of fetching it here. Sign-in cookies are not passed on, so downloads that need an account may fail in the other app.
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_AEROGEL: Named after aerogel, the lightest solid there is.
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_APP_LINKS_SUB: Choose whether links open in installed apps, in Settings › Privacy and security
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_BACKUP_SUB: Tabs, site permissions, settings and flags in one file
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_DAILY_SUB: Allow notifications so you don't miss a new version
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_FROM_FILE_SUB: A .crx or .zip that is already on your phone
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_GUARD_SUB: Privacy, security and speed options in one place, in Settings
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_MORE_EXTENSIONS_SUB: Install from the extension store as usual, Manifest V2 included
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_NO_TELEMETRY_SUB: No telemetry and no big tech services
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_OBTAINIUM_SUB: Or let Obtainium install every update for you
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_PASSWORDS_SUB: Filled by your Android autofill app
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_SUPPORT_TEXT: No ads and no tracking. If you like Aerium, a small donation keeps it going. Thank you.
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_TAGLINE: The browser that stays out of the way.
IDS_AERIUM_FIRST_RUN_WEB_APPS_SUB: Install a site from the menu and it opens like an app
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY: The same privacy protections as Recommended, tuned for speed: pages preload before you click them.
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PRIVACY_SUMMARY: Everything in Recommended, plus browsing data cleared when you close Aerium, search suggestions off so nothing you type leaves the browser, HTTPS-First in strict mode, and no non-proxied UDP for video calls. Expect more warnings on sites with self-signed certificates.
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_APPLY_MESSAGE: Apply NAME? Only the settings this profile names are changed. Everything else stays as it is.
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_APPLY_MESSAGE_F: Apply NAME? Only the settings this profile names are changed. It also turns on these chrome://flags: FLAGS
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_IMPORT_SUMMARY: Add a profile someone shared with you as a .json file
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_INVALID: That is not a valid Aerium Guard profile
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_PASTE_SUMMARY: Add a profile someone shared with you as text
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_ROW_SUMMARY: Tap to apply, share, export or delete
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_SAVE_SUMMARY: Keep this combination under a name, to switch back to it later or share it
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_PROFILE_SAVE_TITLE: Save current settings as a profile
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_RECOMMENDED_SUMMARY: A safe, balanced default: blocks cross-site tracking, keeps pages from loading before you click them, and leaves search suggestions on.
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_SECURITY_SUMMARY: Everything in Recommended, plus fewer ways in for an attacking site: the JavaScript JIT compiler is turned off, only HTTPS connections are allowed, video calls cannot reach your network outside the proxy, and look-alike web addresses are shown in their real form. Some heavy web apps run slower. To allow the JIT for a site you trust, add it in Site settings.
IDS_AERIUM_GUARD_SUMMARY: Set your privacy, security and speed options together
IDS_AERIUM_OPEN_APP_LINKS_SUMMARY: Let installed apps open links they support. When off, links stay in Aerium.
IDS_AERIUM_OPEN_APP_LINKS_TITLE: Allow links to open in apps
IDS_AERIUM_PATCHES_SUMMARY: Every patch applied on top of upstream Chromium
IDS_AERIUM_PURE_BLACK_SUMMARY: Use true black instead of dark grey in dark mode. Saves power on OLED screens, where black pixels are switched off.
IDS_AERIUM_RESTART_TO_APPLY: Restart Aerium to apply this change
IDS_AERIUM_SHARE_TEXT: Aerium is a private Android browser with desktop extensions, Manifest V2 included. No telemetry, no big tech inside. https://aerium-browser.github.io/
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_EMPTY: No rules yet. Every site follows the settings on the previous screen.
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_HINT: example.com - covers the whole site, subdomains included
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_INVALID: Enter a site, such as example.com
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_MODE_EPHEMERAL: Clear this site as soon as its last tab closes
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_MODE_EPHEMERAL_SUM: Cleared when its last tab closes
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_MODE_KEEP: Keep this site when Aerium closes
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_MODE_SESSION: Keep this site until Aerium closes, then clear it
IDS_AERIUM_SITE_RULES_SUMMARY: When each site's data is deleted
IDS_AERIUM_UPDATE_CHECK_SUMMARY: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer Aerium has been released. Nothing is downloaded or installed. Turning this off means you will not be told when a security fix ships.
IDS_AERIUM_UPDATE_NOTIFICATION_TEXT: Aerium VERSION has been released. Tap to open the release on GitHub.
IDS_AERIUM_WEB_APPS_EMPTY: Sites you install from the menu appear here.
